key_insight: The paper shows how to generate graphs that match a target persistence diagram exactly, rather than only approximately, by using topology-imposed constraints.
engineering_relevance: This enables topology-controlled graph generation for scientific and engineering workflows where strict shape or connectivity constraints must be preserved.
method: Local iterative construction of degree-based PD-equivalent graphs with proofs of exact PD realization and reachability.
Global formulation as a complete constraint satisfaction problem solvable with modern constraint programming solvers.
Applicable to any vertex-based permutation-equivariant filtration scheme, and minimal under degree filtration.
evidence_signal: Experiments on four standard graph generation benchmarks show that both proposed methods realize the target persistence diagram exactly.
watch_item: The local method can trade off sample diversity and may reach infeasible states, so the global solver-based approach may be preferable when exactness matters.
paper_title: Exact Topological Compliance: Generating Persistence-Equivalent Graphs
